name: BVG Design Services
primary_cta: Send my request (brief builder on screen 1 writes an email to info@bvgdesign.com); secondary: call Freeport (242) 602-0658
brand_truth: They were getting Bahamian businesses found online in 1996, starting with their own Bahamas Vacation Guide, before most of the Bahamas was online.
buyer: Owners of 2-30 person Bahamian businesses (guesthouses, charters, retailers) who fear paying for a site nobody finds and having nobody local to call.

direction.palette: sand ground, Freeport harbour ink, sun ochre accent for primary actions only
direction.why: Job spec first: the brief builder is the hero beside 'Built and found since 1996.'; their own 1996 Bahamas Vacation Guide rebuilds itself through four eras in a pinned scroll stage and ends by handing back the visitor's request.

concept_type: brochure: one page with a live era demo of their own first site, services, story, offices, steps and an email request builder

pitch_line: Your own first site, the Bahamas Vacation Guide, rebuilds itself from 1996 to a 2026 phone page on the first screen: thirty years of getting Bahamian businesses found, shown instead of told.
assumptions: Nassau and Abaco offices are listed on bvgdesign.com without addresses or numbers; the concept routes them through Freeport
The 2006, 2016 and 2026 layouts of the guide are recreations, labelled as such on the page
